original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.5. Surface Pla: SPR is an efficient method for measure interactions between protein-protein, protein-DNA, small molecule-protein, nucleotide-nucleotide and so on. In this study, we applied SPR to measure the interactions between the newly discovered hit 3 and its analogues towards DOT1L. Firstly, DOT1L protein was prepared in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 5.5) and then covalently immobilized on the CMS sensor chip via amine-coupling procedure. The rest binding sites of the sensor chip were blocked by ethanolamine. The kinetic measurements of compounds were performed at 25 °C with Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare). In this study, compounds were diluted at different concentrations in HBS buffer (10 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA), and were injected over the chip at rate of 30 μL/min. The combining time and dissociation time was set at 120 s and 150 s, respectively. Data analysis was finished via the state model of T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Evaluation of compound 3 DOT1L inhibition activity. (A) Radioactivity assay for compound 3. IC50 value of 3 is 20.94 ± 1.58 μM. (B) SPR binding assay between 3 and DOT1L. Binding curves of 3 with DOT1L are shown. The concentrations of compound ranged from 0.9 μM to 40 μM are indicated. This assay yielded KD value of 9.30 μM for DOT1L binding with compound 3.
original_paragraph.Figure 2B sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 2B shows response units (RU) on the y-axis and time (s) on the x-axis. The curves are labeled with concentrations: 0.90 μM (red), 1.75 μM (blue), 6.71 μM (yellow), 16.38 μM (green), 25.60 μM (cyan), and 40.00 μM (orange). The association phase lasts for 120 s, followed by a 150 s dissociation phase.
original_paragraph.Results - 2.4. Surface Plasmon Resonance: Normally, potential inhibitors could bind to the targeted protein, and then to block its biological function. So in the hit discovery stage, it's necessary to determine whether the potential hits could directly target to proteins. To address the issue, the SPR binding assay was performed to assess the interaction between compound 3 and DOT1L.32 As shown in Figure 2B, the capacity of the interaction was positive correlate with the concentration of compound 3. The result showed that 3 could bind to DOT1L directly in vitro with an equilibrium dissociation constant (KD) of 9.30 μM, which demonstrating it was a potential hit of DOT1L by directly binding to DOT1L protein to inhibit enzyme activity in vitro.
